scope: Entire actions/model_actions.ts, actions/pagination.ts and actions/cursor_pagination.ts; other actions files and lower-level db/utils helpers are dependencies rather than mutated sources.

bugsFound.contract: Configured numbered defaults must be consistent with explicit safe-integer input.
bugsFound.before: createPaginationInputSchema({defaultPageSize: Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 1, maxPageSize: Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 1}).parse(undefined) returned unsafe pageSize9007199254740992, while the equivalent explicit page input failed Zod validation. Number.isInteger accepted unsafe integer configuration, and Zod defaults bypassed field parsing.
bugsFound.regressionEvidence: Two new unsafe defaultPageSize/maxPageSize cases failed on the original source (expected TypeError, received no throw), then passed after the fix.
bugsFound.fix: Validate configured numbered page sizes with Number.isSafeInteger. Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER remains permitted for numbered options; cursor-only lookahead bounds and lower-level numbered window/offset arithmetic are not changed.
